Bookmarks

Team Manager — Admin

1. The app

Team Manager — the app everyone uses (sign in here)
The React app, hosted on Vercel. Rosters, games, stats, draft.
My Account — name, password, API tokens, sync schedule
Admins also set how often the league site is synced here, and can Sync now.
Email — write to parents and coaches, see what was sent
Admin only. Shows who will and won't be reached before sending.
User Management — accounts, roles, set-password links
Admin only. Create users, assign roles, email a set-password link.
Services — status and notices for everything the app runs on
Admin only. Incidents and maintenance from Render, Vercel, Aiven, GitHub, Resend and Claude, plus the app's own health checks.
Usage — who signed in and which pages they opened
Admin only. Counted on the server, so ad blockers don't affect it.
Roster Management — draft, mock draft, requests, trades
Draft room, play-with requests, trades and move history, unplaced players.
Games — schedule, scan scoresheets, fix games
Import Scoresheets is the game sheet scanner.

2. Hosting

Render — runs the API (restart, settings, logs)
Service "gamesheetscanner-api". Environment tab holds DATABASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY, EMAIL_FROM, APP_URL. Manual Deploy restarts it.
API docs — every endpoint, try them in the browser
Also a quick check that the API is awake (free plan sleeps when idle; first load can take a minute).
Vercel — hosts the app at tptm.io (deploys, domain)
Project "frontend". Rebuilds on every push to main.
Vercel Analytics — visitors, countries, devices (open the project, then Analytics)
Needs enabling once per project. Undercounts when ad blockers are on; use the app's Usage page for exact numbers.
Aiven — the Postgres database (status, power, backups, allowed IPs)
Service "game-sheet-scanner-db". Check here first if the database seems down.
Streamlit Cloud — the old app, being retired (delete after Oct 21, 2026)
Kept as a fallback for two weeks after the switch to the React app.

3. Code and automation (GitHub)

GitHub — the project's code and READMEs
Pushing to main deploys both the app (Vercel) and the API (Render).
GitHub Actions — the hourly league sync job (history, Run workflow)
Runs at :15 each hour. Use "Run workflow" for a fresh run, not "Re-run jobs".
GitHub secrets — API_BASE_URL and LEAGUE_SYNC_TOKEN for the sync job
The token comes from My Account in the app. The API address can be a secret or a variable.
GitHub — recent changes (commit history)
Every change made to the app, newest first.

4. Email (Resend)

Resend — every email sent, delivered or bounced
Check here when someone says they didn't get an email.
Resend — the tptm.io sending domain and its DNS records
Must show "verified" for mail to send.
Resend — API keys (create, revoke)
The key in use is RESEND_API_KEY on Render. Free plan: 100 emails a day, 3,000 a month.

5. Outside services

League stats site — where scores and stats are synced from
The sync reads this site's data hourly. If a game is wrong here, it will be wrong in the app.
Anthropic Console — the key and billing for reading scoresheets
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on Render. Each scanned sheet costs a little; usage and limits are here.
YouTube Studio — the "Latest updates" video linked from Home
The video must be Unlisted or Public for users to watch it.
Team Pittsburgh Ball Hockey — the league's public website
The league's own site and branding.
